app.title: Cafeteria management
error.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
home.title: Home
home.empty: No data yet. Start by importing the families Excel file.
import.title: Import the families file
import.help: The Excel file (.xlsx) must contain the columns “nom parent”, “nom enfant” and “adresse email” (or “parent name”, “child name”, “email”). Other columns are ignored.
import.replace_note: The file replaces the current data: children and parents missing from the file will be deleted. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.error.format: Only Excel .xlsx files are accepted. In Excel: File › Save As › Excel Workbook (.xlsx).
import.error.too_large: The file is too large (maximum %d MB).
import.error.unreadable: This file cannot be read. Check that it is an Excel .xlsx file.
import.error.missing_columns: Columns not found: %s. Check the first row of the file.
import.error.stale: The data changed since this check (another import was saved). Import the file again to see up-to-date changes.
import.error.expired: The check has expired. Please import the file again.
import.issue.parent_name_conflict: Same email as an earlier row but another parent name (%s): the first name is kept
preview.title: File check
preview.no_changes: The file is identical to the current data.
preview.errors_help: Fix these rows in the Excel file, then import it again. Nothing can be saved while errors remain.
preview.deleted_help: These children are in the app but no longer in the file. The history of sent emails is kept.
